summary: Differs from checker.md 1.3.1 section 5 (ATIP feedback): (1) a notRun refusal is a stateless step by served_precondition's own list (USAGE, INPUT_*, UNKNOWN_COMMAND, COMMAND_REQUIRED, OPTION_*, a field that starts with -- or /, at L1 a doc-declared code) whereas the ordinary fixture-call test is is_stateless (checks/mod.rs:1139): a precondition refusal that names an argument (NOT_FOUND with field --id) is a false FIXTURE_INVALID, and a registered USAGE replacement with a non-dash field is unprovided; (2) when the fixture has no registry or registry is from-schema every code counts as registered (probe: an unregistered NO_SUCH_CODE gave unprovided, not a fixture error at L1); (3) a notRun command that ends on its own is FIXTURE_INVALID WRONG_SHAPE where prepare/setup failures have their own reasons (PREPARE_FAILED/SETUP_FAILED); (4) the approved brief check-fixture still says 'notRun에 있는 명령을 commands에도 올리면 fixture 오류' (brief line 87) while code, CHANGELOG and checker.md allow it. checker.md should define 'stateless step' for a command refused at its start.
